import random, sys, json, collections
sys.path.insert(0,'/app')
sys.argv=['x']
import fuzz
rng=random.Random(7)
cnt=collections.Counter()
ops=collections.Counter()
sizes=[]
for _ in range(2000):
    p=fuzz.gen_program(rng)
    sizes.append(fuzz.validate(p))
    def walk(x):
        if isinstance(x,list):
            if x and isinstance(x[0],str): ops[x[0]]+=1
            for y in x: walk(y)
    walk(p['body'])
    for n,d in p['cells'].items(): cnt['cellkinds%d'%len(d['types'])]+=1
print('nodes', sum(sizes)/len(sizes), max(sizes))
print('ops', ops)
print(cnt)

cd /tmp/fz && cat > stats2.py <<'PYEOF'
import random, sys, json, collections
sys.path.insert(0,'/app')
sys.argv=['x']
import fuzz2
from interpreter import run
rng=random.Random(11)
ops=collections.Counter(); traces=collections.Counter(); sizes=[]
for _ in range(500):
    p=fuzz2.gen_program(rng)
    sizes.append(fuzz2.validate(p))
    def walk(x):
        if isinstance(x,list):
            if x and isinstance(x[0],str): ops[x[0]]+=1
            for y in x: walk(y)
    walk(p['body'])
    res=run(p)
    for t in res['trace']: traces[t['operation']]+=1
print('nodes avg',sum(sizes)/len(sizes),'max',max(sizes))
print('AST ops:',ops)
print('executed ops:',traces)
PYEOF
timeout 300 python3 stats2.py
